summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the \x1b]0;{title}\x07 format entry and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated on is_terminal like show_cursor; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (non-Windows), test_control_title, and test_control_set_window_title (Windows, mocked). Not run: tests and Black were not executed, per instructions, so formatting and test results are unverified. Nothing was committed.
